phase: Phase D2 - propagation consistency: shadow-event segmented integration, an opt-in consistent propagation profile for the two-way estimators, and a convergence guard (implementation)
written: 2026-10-23, before any D2 number was computed
authorisation: owner re-freeze approval for src/lunar_od/dynamics.py, src/lunar_od/srp.py and src/lunar_od/estimators.py, given 2026-10-23 (AskUserQuestion: 'Onaylıyorum'); defaults flip only later, together with DE440 (C4-I), per the owner's 'D2'den sonra geç'
motivation: D1 (studies/phase17/reports/phase_d1_integrator_characterization.md): F1 VODE Adams at rtol 1e-11 is 0.09-0.26 m off; F2 no shadow events, up to 1.93 m; F3 the estimator's nominal/Jacobian and its candidate cost come from different propagators 0.3-2.0 m apart; F4 BLS-LM declared Converged 13 m from the truth

design.dynamics: propagate_state, propagate_augmented_state (incl. the harmonic branch) and propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity gain a keyword shadow_events: bool = False. When True and SRP is active with shadow_model CONICAL_PENUMBRA, the penumbra outer-contact (gamma = a_sun + a_occ) and inner-contact (gamma = |a_sun - a_occ|) epochs are found by root finding (solve_ivp events) on a state-only DOP853 pre-pass at the caller's tolerances, and the requested propagation is integrated segment by segment, restarting the integrator at each contact epoch with the full (6, 42 or 48) state carried across. The RHS is continuous at a contact, so no saltation correction to the STM or sensitivity is needed. shadow_events=False (default), SRP off or NO_SHADOW: the existing code path, untouched.
design.estimators: estimate_two_way_range_bls_lm and estimate_two_way_range_srif gain propagation_profile: PropagationProfile | None = None. With a profile: (i) every propagation inside the solve (nominal/Jacobian, K-sensitivity, LM/SRIF candidate, rescore, damping-exhaustion relinearisation, posterior) receives method=profile.method and shadow_events=profile.shadow_events; (ii) the early-iteration tolerance loosening (_adaptive_tol) is disabled, so every iteration runs at the caller's rtol/atol - this is the F4 guard: no Converged/J-Stab can be declared on a loosened linearisation; (iii) SRIF scores the incumbent with the same 6-state propagation as the candidate (the BLS Phase 6.2 rule). propagation_profile=None: the existing code path, untouched.

configuration: D1's: KP2 SIMPLIFIED dynamics (Moon point mass + J2 + cannonball SRP at K0, CONICAL_PENUMBRA), CANON / O1_LOW_BETA_ECLIPSE_RICH / O2_FULL_SUN_HIGH_BETA at k0, mu_earth = mu_sun = 0, rtol 1e-11, atol 1e-12
independent_reference: D1's construction re-implemented in the gate script: DOP853 rtol 1e-13 / atol 1e-14 through propagate_state with shadow_events=False, restarted at contact epochs found by bisection of srp._illumination_for on a Hermite-interpolated 10 s DOP853 1e-12 pre-pass (bracket <= 1e-4 s). It shares no event-finding code with the production implementation.

gates.G1_default_invariance: with defaults (shadow_events=False, propagation_profile=None) the three propagators, BLS-LM and SRIF reproduce, bit for bit (np.array_equal), outputs recorded from the unmodified D1-branch code on CANON k0 before any edit (state history, augmented history, K-sensitivity history; one BLS-LM and one SRIF solve with max_iter 3 and their statuses and stats.final_cost); also with SRP off (srp=None) and with NO_SHADOW plus shadow_events=True for the propagators

gates.G3_accuracy: with shadow_events=True and method DOP853 at rtol 1e-11/atol 1e-12, max position error vs the independent reference <= 1 mm over each of the three arcs, for each of the three propagators (state part)
gates.G4_events: the production contact epochs agree with the reference's bisection epochs to <= 1e-3 s, with the same count, on each arc
gates.G5_consistency: under the profile, max |r_state - r_augmented| and |r_state - r_ksens| <= 1 mm on each arc (the F3 mismatch closed)
gates.G6_variational: under the profile on CANON, the STM block of propagate_augmented_state and the dx/dK block of propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity agree with central finite differences of the profile propagate_state (state steps 1 m / 1e-3 m/s, K step 1e-3 K0) at the final epoch: max relative column error <= 1e-5
gates.G7_closure: from the C2-I G6 start (x0 + N(0, PRIOR_SD), seed [98, 0, 0]), CANON k0, range-only six-state, DSN_C2 light time, noise-free observations from the independent reference truth: BLS-LM (max_iter 80) and SRIF (max_iter 40) with the profile each end with status Converged or J-Stab and |r_hat - r_true| <= 1 mm
